name: Voxel Splatting to Pixel Footprints
definition: A rasterization technique where each voxel in a cluster is processed by a single invocation, projecting its footprint box to the pixel centers it covers, replacing the previous method of walking every pixel of a brick's rectangle through its cells.
summary: Voxel splatting to pixel footprints is a rasterization technique that projects voxel footprints to pixels, replacing inefficient pixel-walking methods to solve processing inefficiencies at shallow voxel levels.
